notes:
### 新增

- 新增双页阅读：横向翻页和纵向滚动均支持固定两页配对、整体缩放及独立单页操作；设置页与阅读器共用单／双页偏好，阅读器设置面板提供阅读方向和页面布局两个选择器（#70）。

### 修复

- iOS 更新窗口显示新版本的“新增、修复、变更”说明，分类标题加粗，长内容支持滚动；确认后仍跳转发布页（#69）。

### 变更

- 左右翻页吸附动画调整为 2 倍速；阅读设置恢复为右上角按钮处弹出的菜单，垂直双页增加“按宽度对齐／按高度对齐”选项并保存偏好。

### 已知限制

summary.classification_reason: Display existing Added, Fixed and Changed release notes in the iOS update dialog using shared Android heading styles while preserving release-page navigation.
summary.subject: fix(updates): show release notes in iOS update dialog

summary.classification_reason: Introduce double-page reading in all three directions with shared zoom, per-page actions, persistent layout preferences and original-page navigation.
summary.subject: feat(reader): add paired-page reading and shared preferences

summary.classification_reason: Refine existing paired-page reading with twice-speed horizontal settling, persistent vertical spread alignment and a button-anchored settings menu.
summary.subject: fix(reader): refine paging speed and anchored spread settings
